text: PTSB confirms that BAWAG's scheme will proceed as planned with court hearing scheduled for 27 October 2026
New HF entrant: Glazer Capital declares 1.95%
2 new HF entrants: Sand Grove (8.88%) & Samson Rock (1.50%)

PTSB has not yet met with Axis or provided requested due diligence information. Axis believes it is entitled to receive the information and intends to ask the Court for an adjournment of BAWAG's scheme proceedings
